title: Cloudflare reports millions of attempts after PHP flaw disclosure
extract: Cloudflare says attempts against newly disclosed PHP flaws rose from thousands before disclosure to millions afterwards. Developers have released fixes, and some operators temporarily restricted services while updating affected systems.

title: Anthropic unveils Claude Duet AI agent app
extract: Anthropic has introduced Claude Duet, a standalone agent app for daily briefings and tasks such as scheduling, financial forecasts and web apps. Its waitlisted research preview connects to thousands of integrations and requires approval for sensitive actions.

title: Microsoft details campaign targeting ConnectWise Cloud Backup
extract: Microsoft attributes a global campaign targeting hundreds of organisations to the Storm-0940 group, which used an open-source security-testing framework. The investigation found several cases of elevated cloud access across finance, government, aerospace and energy.

title: Flight Simulator II over Chicago
extract: A new Apple II+ demonstration runs subLOGIC's Flight Simulator II version 2.0 from an original disk image. The repeatable flight leaves Meigs Field, passes Chicago's towers, dives into Lake Michigan and finishes with a night-time runway view.

title: AmigaOS 3.x gets an OpenSSH 10.6 client and key generator
extract: AmiBash now packages OpenSSH 10.6's ssh client and ssh-keygen for AmigaOS 3.x on 68020-or-newer systems. The port works without OpenSSL and supports modern key and key-exchange algorithms; it has been tested under AROS and FS-UAE.

title: ESP32 emulator adds runtime-selectable Motorola 68k CPU support
extract: The ESP32-based emulator can now choose its Motorola 68k CPU type at runtime rather than compiling a fixed processor variant. That lets Amiga A500 and A1200 configurations share one firmware image; the author reports no slowdown in a host-side Kick Off 2 comparison.

title: Emuwiz adds ZX Spectrum media inspection and preservation-only RZX recordings
extract: Emuwiz adds structural inspection for Spectrum PZX, NEX, UDI and MDR media formats, distinguishing validated, partial, unsupported and ambiguous files. RZX gameplay recordings are now preserved as records rather than launchable games, with fingerprint checks to detect later changes.

title: Applecorn runs BBC Micro language ROMs on an Apple IIe
extract: A new Applecorn demonstration runs BBC Micro language ROMs unchanged on an enhanced Apple IIe through a BBC operating-system implementation for ProDOS. The page shows BBC BASIC graphics and examples in COMAL, Lisp, Forth, micro-PROLOG, BCPL and Pascal.

title: FES advances C64 FPGA emulation with native 1541 drive firmware and MOS6581 audio
extract: The open-source FPGA-based Fogger Expandable System is pushing its Commodore 64 implementation closer to original hardware behaviour. Recent work runs 1541 disk-drive firmware on a development CPU and VIA, adds native PAL timing and continues cycle-level fixes for the VIC, CIA, CPU and disk interface.

title: Unreal-NG improves Spectrum Next extended keys and host keyboard mapping
extract: The emulator now handles the ZX Spectrum Next's 16 extended membrane keys as distinct inputs and improves punctuation, keypad and shortcut mapping across host operating systems. The update also refines keyboard overlays for the Spectrum+, Next, Forum and Profi configurations.

title: Spatterlight restores Finder previews for Spectrum, C64 and Apple II game files
extract: Spatterlight's Quick Look preview and thumbnail extensions now cover more interactive-fiction and retro-game formats, including Spectrum snapshots and tapes, Commodore 64 disk and tape images, and Apple II disk images. The change also fixes an extension-registration bug that prevented thumbnails for later file types.

title: Moria8 begins an Atari 8-bit port of the classic roguelike
extract: Moria8, an assembly port of the classic Moria roguelike, has added an in-progress Atari 8-bit target. The project already has released builds for the Commodore 64, Plus/4, C128 and Apple II, with more vintage platforms planned.

title: MAME Home Systems improves keyboard layouts across emulated machines
extract: The MAME Home Systems core now displays keyboards in rows using each machine's matrix or named keys, including Amstrad CPC models, the BBC Micro and TI-83. It also separates joystick and controller entries that were previously interleaved.

title: On Another Planet They Can Save Me by Lieke Marsman review
extract: The late Dutch poet Lieke Marsman's posthumous memoir explores how terminal illness unsettled her rational worldview, including her ideas about God and extraterrestrial life. The review describes a playful, humane book arguing for openness and hope when certainty breaks down.
